items.title: Ray Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: It was the Jerry Lewis Theater originally.

ctx.x: Do you recall any times when things really fell apart?

No. That’s interesting. Of course it got to be, with tape, at first it was you were live to the east coast. I guess they still do like “The Tonight Show” and all that, it’s live to the east coast, and they make a tape as they’re doing a live show and they play that for the west coast. But it got to be that if there was a goof, it wasn’t live ever, it was just taped. Oh Jerry Lewis, do you remember, he tried to do a live, boy he really wanted to do it live, and that was just before the Hollywood Palace went on. It…
